thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — DeltaLens (enterprise) reporting a sudden drop in rerank precision after last week's model swap. Raising to product for triage. They say top-3 contains irrelevant KB articles now. Examples attached.
Jordan (PM): Thanks Maya. Do we know which model/version and whether they changed any indexing parameters on their side?
Maya (CS): Customer details: DeltaLens; use-case = support article reranking; embedding model reported by them: text-embed-redwood-002 v3; dim=1536; index = faiss IVF+PQ (pq=8). They say they didn't change pipeline, they migrated to dedicated region 3 days ago.
Liam (Eng): Can you paste a before/after example so we can repro? Also need the embed model hash or exact artifact name.
Maya (CS): Provided snippets:

Before (2/24 snapshot):
1) "Reset password for org users" — score 0.92
2) "SSO setup guide" — score 0.88
3) "API key rotation" — score 0.84

After (3/12 snapshot):
1) "Billing update policy" — score 0.87  <-- irrelevant
2) "SSO setup guide" — score 0.80
3) "Legacy connector notes" — score 0.75

Also attached: small CSV of 30 queries + expected top-3 labels.
Liam (Eng): OK. Preliminary checklist:
- Verify embedding artifact id and vector dims
- Compare raw embedding cosine distances between snapshots
- Check IVF centroids drift + PQ quantization impact
- Reproduce locally with their index file / sample vectors

Estimate: if rollback to previous embedding variant is sufficient, we can push a temporary rollback + reindex for the customer in ~2 days. If issue is index quantization/IVF mismatch, a targeted reindex + PQ retune is ~3 days. Full reranker retrain / fine-tune = 3-4 weeks.
Sophia (Sales): DeltaLens is high-touch and on a committed contract. They flagged SLA + potential credits. Need ETA and recommended immediate mitigation.
Jordan (PM): Options to propose to customer (ranked by speed/risk):
1) Rollback to prior embed model variant on their tenant (lowest risk, quickest)
2) Quick reindex with different PQ settings (moderate risk, medium effort)
3) Change similarity normalization / rerank heuristics (low effort A/B)
4) Full reranker retrain (longest)

We need acceptance criteria to unblock prioritization: repro dataset (>=20 labeled queries) + measurable delta metric (top-3 precision drop >= X%). Proposed launch criteria for a fix: repro for >=70% of provided cases AND A/B lift >=8% top-3 precision vs current.
Maya (CS): Customer can provide 50 labeled queries within 48h and is okay with a rollback as first mitigation.
Liam (Eng): I'll create a reproducible test harness. Can someone from CS upload: (a) their index snapshot (small sample) (b) vector outputs for 20 failing queries (c) exact model artifact id. If they can't share index, embeddings + queries will do.
Maya (CS): Upload link incoming in 30m. Customer asked if we can do rollback ourselves or if they need to. They prefer us to handle it.
Jordan (PM): Proposed prioritization: mark as P1 customer escalation, schedule a focused fix sprint next week (2 devs + 1 SRE). If rollback works, ship as hotfix and close. If not reproducible, escalate to rerank roadmap (longer work).
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2026-0432 assigned to eng-rerank; priority=P1; pager=oncall-eng.
Liam (Eng): I'll take initial ownership. Scheduling deep-dive w/ DeltaLens + CS tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need dataset and their permission for a temporary config rollback.
Sophia (Sales): I'll send the migration & SLA notes to legal if they want to share their index. Also flagged to account manager about potential credit exposure.
Maya (CS): Meeting invite sent. I'll post the upload + customer labels here after call. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
notes: escalation thread capturing CS -> PM -> Eng handoff, options, rough estimates, and explicit launch criteria requested by PM
